notes: Expanded to 6 total stories (2 existing + 4 new). No duplicates created. Coverage now includes core mapping, error handling, and integration.

stories.title: Map Board Certification Fields from NPI Registry Response
stories.description: Implement mapping logic from raw NPI registry response fields (taxonomy, credentials, enumeration data) into structured board certification objects used by the evaluation domain.

stories.title: Handle Missing or Incomplete Board Certification Data
stories.description: Implement defensive logic to handle cases where NPI registry data lacks certification indicators, contains inconsistent credential formats, or returns partial records, ensuring graceful degradation and clear output flags.

stories.title: Integrate Board Certification Logic into Provider Detail Service
stories.description: Embed board certification extraction, normalization, and verification into provider_detail_service so results are included in provider detail payloads returned by the domain layer.

stories.title: End-to-End Integration Test for Board Certification Flow
stories.description: Implement integration tests validating the full flow from NPI lookup through provider_detail_service to evaluate_care_facade, ensuring board certification data is correctly surfaced in API responses.
